messages:
Maria C.: Heads up — several EU onboardings started failing with 401s after an automated token rotation at ~03:05 UTC, looks like webhook auth rejected callbacks. Collecting affected tenant IDs now. :rotating_light:
Jonah L.: seeing identical errors in the proxy logs, header: Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>, upstream returns 401.
Priya N.: Any recent deploys to the webhook proxy?
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: webhook-proxy eu-west v1.14.3 by @deploy-ops at 03:02 UTC.
Evan M.: Confirmed rotation happened as part of secret-sync job. Secret version mismatch between proxy and router.
Priya N.: sample proxy log:
```
WARN auth_middleware: token verification failed tenant=acct-0a3 status=401 err="token mismatch"
ERROR webhook-handler: callback failed tenant=acct-ff2 attempts=3
```
Aisha R.: We're preparing customer comms. Do we want to batch or send individualized notes? High-touch first?
Maria C.: High-touch first (enterprise + renewal soon). Templates for others. Offer immediate replay and a one-time onboarding credit.
Jonah L.: Immediate mitigation: 1) rollback secret-sync change to previous key (rolling restart), 2) enqueue replay of failed webhooks, 3) add alert if >5 401s per tenant in 10m. Rolling restart started.
sre-oncall-bot: Alert: increased 401s for webhook-proxy eu-west (since 03:05 UTC).
Evan M.: Rollback completed at 03:20 UTC, proxy started accepting callbacks. Replay job enqueued for 1,200 failed webhooks.
Priya N.: Draft high-touch note: "Hi <CustomerName>, we observed failed webhook callbacks affecting tenant provisioning between 03:05103:20 UTC in eu-west. The issue was caused by a secret rotation mismatch; engineers rolled back the rotation and reprocessed failed events. Next steps: we scheduled a targeted replay for your tenant and offered a $200 onboarding credit. We'll follow up with a full RCA within 48 hours. If you'd like an expedited replay window, reply and we'll prioritize."
Maria C.: Add clear ETA: "most replays should finish within 1 hour; if your tenant still shows incomplete setup after 90 minutes, notify us".
Aisha R.: Flagged 3 accounts with renewals in 14 days — notifying AMs now. AM-bot: ping sent to AMs for accounts acct-ff2, acct-3b9, acct-a12.
Jonah L.: Post-incident tasks: 1) prevent automated rotations during active onboarding windows; 2) add canary verification after secret-sync; 3) improve replay visibility in CS console. Creating ENG ticket ENG-7709.
Priya N.: I'm adding an opt-in office hours slot at 11:00 UTC and a troubleshooting doc link: https://redwood.ai/docs/onboarding-webhooks#replay-faq
Maria C.: CS action items: - Send high-touch notes by 07:30 UTC - Batch template at 08:30 UTC - Run office hours and route live escalations to @Jonah
Evan M.: Metrics to dump for RCA: secret-sync audit log, proxy cert/key versions, replay queue latency, and auth failure histogram. I'll attach to ENG-7709.
sre-oncall-bot: Alert cleared at 03:23 UTC (401 spike resolved).
Aisha R.: I'll offer a one-time onboarding credit and record consent in the CRM. Any objections to $200 for paid tiers, $50 for trials?
Maria C.: fine. For renewal-risk accounts let's escalate to director if they ask for more.
AM-bot: AMs acknowledged, will follow up with exec outreach for any at-risk renewals.
Priya N.: After comms, we'll capture verbatim replies in the onboarding feedback sheet and tag tickets for immediate SRE follow-up where necessary.
Maria C.: Good work team. We'll publish the RCA draft in 48 hours and push a customer-facing summary to the status page. :white_check_mark:
